parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $\frac{\mathrm d(PQ)}{\mathrm dt}=4-3t^2$. — B1FT. Guidance: B1FT for differentiation of their $PQ$, which MUST be a cubic expression, but can be $\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dx}f(x)$ from (i), but not the equation of the curve. Set $=0\to t=+\frac{2}{\sqrt3}$. — M1. Guidance: Setting their differential of $PQ$ to 0 and attempt to solve for $t$ or $x$. Maximum $PQ=\frac{16}{3\sqrt3}$ or $\frac{16\sqrt3}{9}$. — A1. Guidance: Allow 3.08 awrt. If answer comes from wrong method in (i), award A0. Correct answer from correct expression by T&I scores 3/3. Total 3.
